purpose: Locally mirror and index game dialogue transcripts sourced from The Imperial Library for evidence-backed lore retrieval.

storage_policy.git: manifests, schemas, provenance, crawl state, hashes and extracted metadata
storage_policy.local: full transcript bodies and derived search indexes

rules: Preserve dialogue wording locally without paraphrasing.
Keep player prompts paired with responses where present.
Do not treat every character statement as objective truth; speaker provenance is mandatory.
Prefer transcript pages over lore summaries.
Cross-link later direct game-data extraction as a stronger witness without deleting the TIL transcription witness.
